sloka: इत्युक्त्वाऽथ विनिष्क्रम्य ददर्श मुनिसत्तमः ।महिषं पर्वताकारं गतासुं पतितं भुवि ॥४-११-५१॥।।
transliteration: ityuktvā'tha viniṣkramya dadarśa munisattamaḥ ।mahiṣaṁ parvatākāraṁ gatāsuṁ patitaṁ bhuvi ॥4-11-51॥।।

translations.english: 'The venerable sage came out of the hermitage and saw a mountaneous buffalo fallen dead on the floor.
